name: stereo_48k
character: The certified stereo master at 48 kHz, the rate picture and broadcast work in. Same mix, resampled last; the true peak is measured again at the new rate.
label: stereo master, 48 kHz
sources: EBU R 128 / ITU-R BS.1770-5: loudness and true peak are measured on the delivered samples, so the peak is re-measured after resampling
`rate_hz` works on any output preset; the engine itself still renders at 44.1 kHz
